source_text: {Having established that $\sigma$ vanishes, it is easy to see that \eqref{eq:maxwell-weak-slack}--\eqref{eq:maxwell-weak-magnetic} imply the Maxwell equations. Equation~\eqref{eq:maxwell-weak-slack} is a weak restatement of \eqref{eq:maxwell-electric-divergence}, \eqref{eq:maxwell-weak-electric} of \eqref{eq:maxwell-ampere}, and \eqref{eq:maxwell-weak-magnetic} of \eqref{eq:maxwell-faraday}. Finally \eqref{eq:maxwell-magnetic-divergence} follows from \eqref{eq:maxwell-faraday} since $\operatorname{div}B(0)=0$.}
translated_text: {已经证明 $\sigma$ 为零后, 容易看出 \eqref{eq:maxwell-weak-slack}--\eqref{eq:maxwell-weak-magnetic} 蕴含 Maxwell 方程. 方程 \eqref{eq:maxwell-weak-slack} 是 \eqref{eq:maxwell-electric-divergence} 的弱形式重述, \eqref{eq:maxwell-weak-electric} 是 \eqref{eq:maxwell-ampere} 的弱形式重述, 而 \eqref{eq:maxwell-weak-magnetic} 是 \eqref{eq:maxwell-faraday} 的弱形式重述. 最后, 由于 $\operatorname{div}B(0)=0$, \eqref{eq:maxwell-magnetic-divergence} 可由 \eqref{eq:maxwell-faraday} 推出.}
